title: Tablets and Writing
summary: Messages could be written on tablets so they could be preserved, read, posted, copied, or carried by messengers.
background: Habakkuk is told to write the vision plainly. This background highlights the public, durable, and accountable nature of written prophetic testimony.
teachingHelp: Show that God’s word is not a private impression only; it is given to be heard, remembered, and obeyed.
